lastTask: Implement Byte 11a automatic melody slow-thinking loop

projectState.summary: Byte 11a is implemented on `codex/byte-11`: the requested invalid-200 smoke fixture is in place, and melody now has an automatic slow-thinking loop gated by playing transport, rehearsal mode, and ready Ollama health. The loop sends one request at a time, passes abort signals, marks melody thinking while pending, stores accepted/invalid/failed/retargeted state in the Thoughts inspector and `window.thinking.getSlowLoop()`, and still does not schedule model output into audio. Build is green and smoke is 14/14. Next slice should add the first narrow compiler from accepted intent to future playback.
